bio.text: The Division of Durack is an Australian electoral division in the state of Western Australia. It is the largest electorate in Australia by land area, at 1,410,947 km2. It stretches all the way along the coast from Guilderton to the Northern Territory border.

tags.label: Vocation-heavy
tags.meaning: Bottom quartile of electorates by share holding a bachelor's degree or higher

tags.label: >10% First Nations
tags.meaning: >10% of the electorate is First Nations
